cause_quote: The new mismatch branch `: () => undefined;` gave the entire settled batch a rejecting Gateway resolver when even one sibling was unbound.
user_saw: After yielding, a requester could miss several finished child results and receive no failure notice because one sibling lacked a live Gateway binding.
summary: The fix preserves Gateway bindings at registration, settles compatible children independently, and records a visible failure when a child's delivery owner is retired.
reasoning: The parent of #132090 already dispatched yielded child batches and returned no explicit resolver for mixed bindings, allowing delivery when a live Gateway request scope was available. #132090 made a mixed batch carry an explicit rejecting resolver, and #137606 later made the same bound-and-unbound mismatch throw before dispatch. The earlier fallback is visible in the code, while successful delivery after restoration before #132090 is unverified.
